title: Velvety Saudi-Arabian Duck Tagine
description: A rich and flavorful Moroccan-inspired dish featuring slow-cooked duck in a creamy herb-infused sauce, served with crispy saffron flatbread.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat the ghee over medium heat.
Add the duck confit and cook until browned on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Add the cilantro, parsley, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, turmeric, and black pepper to the pot.
Pour in 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 hour.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for an additional 30 minutes.
While the tagine is baking, prepare the saffron flatbread by mixing 1 cup of flour, 1/4 cup of ghee, and 1/4 cup of warm water in a bowl.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes and shape into a ball.
Place the dough on a baking sheet and bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve the velvety duck tagine over the crispy saffron flatbread.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and parsley, if desired.
